name: Swashbuckler
summary: A charming duelist who fights one-on-one with flair.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.short: Creatures you attack can't make opportunity attacks against you.
features.summary: During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.short: Add CHA to initiative; Sneak Attack in a one-on-one duel.
features.summary: You add your Charisma modifier to initiative rolls. You can Sneak Attack a creature without advantage if you are within 5 ft. of it, no other creature is within 5 ft. of you, and you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Panache
features.short: Charm or taunt a creature with a Persuasion contest.
features.summary: As an action, make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Insight. A hostile creature has disadvantage attacking anyone but you for 1 minute; a non-hostile one is charmed.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.short: Bonus action: advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check.
features.summary: You can use a bonus action to gain advantage on the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make this turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.short: Reroll a missed attack with advantage.
features.summary: If you miss with an attack roll, you can roll it again with advantage. Once per short or long rest.
